nodes.summary: Given a valuation $v$ assigning a Boolean to each atom, the Boolean structure of $v$ is the structure for the first-order language of propositional atoms whose domain is the set of Booleans $\{\mathrm{false}, \mathrm{true}\}$ and in which the nullary relation symbol of an atom $a$ holds exactly when $v(a)$ is true. The language has no function symbols, so nothing else needs to be interpreted.
nodes.title: Boolean structure of a valuation

nodes.summary: The translation of propositions over a type of atoms into sentences of the first-order language of propositional atoms, defined by recursion: an atom $a$ becomes the atomic sentence given by the nullary relation symbol of $a$, and $A \wedge B$, $A \vee B$ and $A \to B$ become the conjunction, the disjunction and the implication of the translations of $A$ and $B$.
nodes.title: Embedding propositions as first-order sentences

nodes.summary: For a type of atoms, the first-order language whose relation symbols are exactly one nullary relation symbol for each atom, with no relation symbols of positive arity and no function symbols.
nodes.title: First-order language of propositional atoms

nodes.summary: For a type of atoms, the family of relation symbols indexed by arity that consists of one nullary relation symbol for each atom $a$ and has no relation symbols of positive arity.
nodes.title: Relation symbols of the propositional language

nodes.summary: For every valuation $v$ assigning a Boolean to each atom and every proposition $A$, the first-order sentence obtained by embedding $A$ is true in the Boolean structure of $v$ if and only if the truth-table value of $A$ under $v$ is true.
nodes.title: The embedding of propositions preserves truth-table semantics

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
